skill.summary: Recommend travel destinations based on vibe, budget, duration, and group size. Handles "suggest a trip", "where should I go", "weekend getaway", "compare X v...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of trip-discover: personalized travel recommendations based on vibe, budget, duration, and group size.
- Supports trip suggestions, destination comparisons, and plans from users’ saved places or wishlists.
- Extracts key criteria from requests; defaults to Delhi as starting city if not specified.
- Provides concise, real-time recommendations with travel details, estimated costs, and seasonal weather.
- Opinionated, max three destination suggestions per request; always checks memory for saved places before suggesting new ones.
